web.title: GTA 6 Still On Track For November Release, Marketing Campaign ...
web.description:
[Skip to content](https://www.gamespot.com/articles/gta-6-still-on-track-for-november-release/1100-6537831/#content)

Advertisement

As part of Take-Two’s earnings announcement today, the company confirmed that Rockstar’s [Grand Theft Auto VI](https://www.gamespot.com/articles/grand-theft-auto-6-everything-we-know/1100-6503729/) remains on track for release on November 19, 2026. There was no reason to believe it might be delayed again, but the company said today that it remains on track.

Advertisement

Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick told [IGN](https://www.ign.com/articles/gta-6-marketing-will-kick-off-this-summer-as-take-two-confidently-reaffirms-november-release-date) that marketing for GTA 6 will begin in earnest this summer.
